info.name: LEAP_calorimeter
info.title: LEAP calorimeter (single cell)
info.author: translated from leap_sims/src/Calorimeter.cc
info.comment: Partial DD4hep translation of the LEAP lead glass calorimeter. Only the calorimeter mother volume and a single calorimeter cell are described here; see src/LEAPCalorimeter_geo.cpp for the list of things that are still missing (3x3 crystal array, PEEK front plate, aluminium top/bottom plates, tracker-like virtual detector planes).

define.comment: The DetType_* constants used in the type_flag below
The world. The original uses a 4 m half side box of air, and DD4hep fills the world with air as well.

Extent of the "tracker region". ddsim's default UserParticleHandler needs these two constants for the MC truth linking, so they have to exist even though there is no tracker in this setup yet. Covering the whole world keeps every particle in the MC truth relation.

Calorimeter cell parameters, cf. Calorimeter::ConstructCalo(). These are the *primitive* numbers only; all derived sizes (air gap, wrapping and cell envelope dimensions) are computed by the detector constructor.
Thickness of the virtual detector planes in front of/behind a cell

Position of the calorimeter mother volume in the world. The original places it at magThick + [Calorimeter] dist2Pol + caloLength/2 behind the solenoid, which is not part of this translation yet. The value below is dist2Pol = 91 mm plus half the cell length, i.e. the calorimeter front face sits 91 mm downstream of the origin.

display.comment: The mother and cell envelopes are virtual volumes -> invisible
Colours as in the G4VisAttributes of the original

detector.name: LEAPCal
detector.comment: Number of cells in x and y. The full calorimeter is a 3x3 array ([Calorimeter] nCrystals = 9); only a single cell is translated so far.
The lead glass crystal. caloMaterial = TF1 in the original config.ini
Air gap between crystal and wrapping, on the front face and the sides
Reflective aluminium foil wrapped around the crystal

Virtual scoring planes in front of and behind the cell. These are passive for now, see the comment in the detector constructor: a calorimeter readout cannot produce hits in vacuum, so they need to become their own `tracker` type subdetector.

readout.name: LEAPCalHits
readout.comment: One cell id per crystal, no sub-segmentation. `slice` distinguishes the front virtual detector (0), the crystal (1) and the back virtual detector (2).
